text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hello, I'm here to explain what training
for the
Twinkle Star Climax will look
like.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Would you like an explanation?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: What would you like me to explain?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'd like to know more about...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Ah yes, your career goals.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You'll be training with the ultimate goal
of
entering the TS Climax.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The first step is to enter races and earn
Result
Points based on your
performance. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You'll need to earn a certain number of
Result
Points each year, though the
amount may differ
depending on the
year.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If you don't acquire enough Result
Points by the
end of late December each
year, your career will
come to an end!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Placing well in higher graded races will
earn you a
greater number of Result
Points.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Additionally, you'll sometimes face
particularly
strong opponents during
races!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
These runners will appear as "rivals" on
the race
entry screen.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You can even acquire skill hints by
defeating a
rival, so do your best to
seize victory!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, unlike what you may be
used to,
this time there aren't any goals
specific to each
individual Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
This means you can take on a wider
variety of
races, including ones you
couldn't enter before!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
You'll have to use your discretion to
choose the
most suitable races for your
trainee. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
During your career, you might catch new
glimpses
of daily life at the academy. I'm
sure that'll be
fun!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes my rundown of career
goals. Is
there anything else you'd like to
know?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
So you want to know about the TS
Climax?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If you earn the required number of
Result Points
during each career interval,
you'll be able to
enter the TS Climax.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Consisting of three successive races, the
TS
Climax is a very special event for
runners!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Victory Points are awarded after each
race based
on placing, and the runner
with the most points
across all three
races is crowned the winner. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The lineup of runners entering each race
will
remain the same, but they'll grow
tougher as you
progress.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Train your runner for a chance to enter
the TS
Climax, then vie to become
Twinkle Top Star!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes my rundown of the TS
Climax. Is
there anything else you'd like
to know?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
So you want to know about the Pro Shop

accessible during your career?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
In addition to Result Points, races will
reward you
with shop coins!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The better you place, the more shop
coins you'll
earn. These coins can then
be spent at the Pro
Shop. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The Pro Shop offers a variety of useful
training
items in exchange for coins!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
These items can raise attributes,
replenish
Energy, boost training
effectiveness, and more!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Be sure to make the most of the Pro
Shop as you
train your partner. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Please be aware that the Pro Shop is
only
available after your trainee
completes her
junior-year Make Debut
race.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Also, don't forget that the lineup of
training items
on sale will change after a
certain amount of time.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If there's an item you have your eye on, I

recommend you gather enough shop
coins to get
it while you can.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, sales are sometimes held at
random
when the lineup changes, during
which you can
obtain items at lower
prices than usual!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
I also hear that extra training items are
sometimes
added to the shop after a
race finishes.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
So make sure you check out the Pro
Shop
whenever you get the chance. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes my rundown of the Pro
Shop. Is
there anything else you'd like to
know?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
So you want to know about the Best
Umamusume
Awards?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The URA presents these awards to the

Umamusume judged to be the best in
their
respective years.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
One outstanding runner each from
junior, classic,
and senior years is chosen
for these highly
prestigious honors.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Selection occurs at the end of December
each
year, after the year's final races
have concluded.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Recipients are chosen based on a variety
of
factors, including race results and
number of fans
for that year. ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Make sure to train hard, make good use
of
training items from the shop, and take
on as many
races as you can!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That concludes my rundown of the Best

Umamusume Awards. Is there anything
else you'd
like to know?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Very well! ♪ Just in case, I've prepared a
summary
of everything you'll need to
know.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If you ever need a refresher, simply tap
the "i"
button in the top left of the
screen.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well, I wish you the best of luck. I'll be
cheering
you on!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Okay. Well, I wish you the best of luck.
I'll be
cheering you on!
